# ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_network_service_config_advertised_routes (Data Source)

Use the `cloud_router_network_service_config_advertised_routes` data source to get BGP routes advertised to peers on a network service config

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_network_service_config_advertised_routes" "example" {
  network_service_config_id = "123"
}

output "advertised_routes" {
  value = data.ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_network_service_config_advertised_routes.example.routes
}

output "first_route_prefix" {
  value = length(data.ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_network_service_config_advertised_routes.example.routes) > 0 ? data.ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_network_service_config_advertised_routes.example.routes[0].prefix : null
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_service_config_id` (String) Network service config ID

### Optional

- `routes` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--routes))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Optional:

- `as_path` (List of String) AS path as list of ASNs
- `next_hop` (String) Next hop IP address
- `prefix` (String) Network prefix in CIDR notation
- `received_at` (String) Timestamp when the route was received
